description: Defines layout details for B matrix in mixed GEMM operations, including specializations for different architectures and data types, used in quantized weight matrix organization for CUTLASS.

classes.name: LayoutDetailsB
classes.description: Template struct providing layout details for matrix B in GEMM, specialized for different architectures and data types.

methods.name: LayoutDetailsB<TypeB, arch::Sm70>
methods.description: Specialization for Volta architecture, uses row-major layout and 8 elements per access.

methods.name: LayoutDetailsB<half_t, Arch>
methods.description: Specialization for FP16 data type on Turing+ architectures, with elements per access based on bit size.

methods.name: LayoutDetailsB<bfloat16_t, Arch>
methods.description: Specialization for BFloat16 data type on Turing+ architectures.

methods.name: LayoutDetailsB<uint8_t, Arch>
methods.description: Specialization for quantized 8-bit unsigned int, uses column-major tile interleave layout with dequantize operator.

methods.name: LayoutDetailsB<uint4b_t, Arch>
methods.description: Specialization for 4-bit quantized data, similar layout to uint8_t with dequantize operator.
